services.value: RJA Labs provides nutritional supplement testing, including vitamins (e.g., Vitamin A & Carotenoids, Vitamin B & Water-Soluble Vitamins, Vitamin C, Vitamin D/K, Vitamin E), elements and heavy metals, microbiological tests, and other chemical tests, with additional analytes upon request. It also offers drinking water and waste water testing (e.g., drinking water quality parameters and wastewater environmental water quality including ammonia, nitrate & nitrite, phosphorus, and BOD), plus local sample pick up and electronic chain of custody using Queue-C Alpha.
